# Eat Real Food NYC
# https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com
# AI Agent Context File — llms.txt
# Last updated: 2026-11-24

## What this site is

Eat Real Food NYC is a curated healthy restaurant directory covering all five
boroughs of New York City. Every published listing is tied to an official NYC
Department of Health inspection record. This site helps users find restaurants
by dietary tag, neighbourhood, health grade, and rating.

## Site owner

Founders: Sanket Desai and Rohan Kadam
Contact: hello@eatrealfoodnyc.com
Press: press@eatrealfoodnyc.com
Partnerships: partner@eatrealfoodnyc.com

## Primary use cases for AI agents

1. Finding healthy restaurants in a specific NYC neighbourhood or borough
2. Filtering restaurants by dietary tag (vegan, halal, kosher, gluten-free, etc.)
3. Identifying Grade A health-inspected restaurants
4. Discovering hidden gem restaurants (high-rated, low-review-count)
5. Comparing NYC neighbourhoods by restaurant health scores

Best Italian Restaurants in NYC: Top 10 Ranked:
  https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/guides/best-italian-restaurants-nyc
  Ten currently open Italian restaurants ranked by official NYC DOHMH
  inspection score, then violation count. Every grade, score, and date
  was matched to Open Data dataset 43nn-pn8j. Re-checked 2026-11-24;
  unchanged from the 2026-11-23 verification.
Best Pizza Restaurants in NYC (2026): Top 10 Ranked:
  https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/guides/best-pizza-restaurants-nyc
  Ten published pizza listings ranked by official NYC DOHMH inspection
  score, then violation count, not by taste. Every grade, score, and date
  was matched to Open Data dataset 43nn-pn8j on 2026-11-24. The newest
  inspection_date in that pull was 2026-11-22.
Grade A Restaurants by Borough: 3 NYC Matches (2026):
  https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/guides/grade-a-restaurants-by-borough-nyc
  Five recent YouTube Shorts, one kitchen in each borough, checked on
  2026-11-24. Three latest DOHMH inspections are Grade A and match the
  listing. Ali's Trinbago Roti Shop and Pho Hoang are not in that count:
  their latest inspections have no letter.
NYC Health Grades Explained: https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/guides/nyc-health-grades-explained
Healthy breakfast in NYC: https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/guides/healthy-breakfast-nyc
  Published restaurants open by 8 AM on weekdays. Grade A counts come from the NYC DOHMH inspection on each listing.
Holiday party catering: https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/catering/holiday-party-catering-nyc
  Office holiday catering and Thanksgiving week requests in NYC.
  The directory does not record a catering menu. The page lists published
  Grade A restaurants for group orders. The request form is free for the
  person sending it. Leads are saved on catering_leads.
Catering request form: https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/catering
Grade A Eats This Week: https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/newsletter
  Archive: https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/newsletter/issues
  Each Thursday issue lists published restaurants whose NYC DOHMH grade is A
  and whose inspection date falls in that week's seven days. The sitemap
  includes an issue from the last 12 weeks when that week has at least 3
  Grade A listings. Older roundups stay on the site. The email edition
  started in November 2026.

## Paths agents should not request

robots.txt disallows these. They are app UI or private endpoints, not documents:

- https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/search
- https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/near-me
- https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/compare
- https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/saved
- https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/api/

Use the borough, neighbourhood, and dietary hubs above, or the sitemap, instead of the search API.

Editorial & Partnership Policy: https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/about/editorial-standards
  Listing is free. Health grades, Health Scores, dietary tags, hidden-gem status,
  and default rankings are never for sale. Clearly labeled Partner and Sponsored
  placements may be offered. They do not change official inspection data or organic sort.

Partner with us: https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/partner-with-us
  Optional labeled placements for eligible restaurants. Payment never changes
  grades, scores, dietary tags, or rankings.
  Monthly tiers: Featured $49/month, Spotlight $149/month,
  Neighborhood Sponsor $299/month.
  Inquiry offers: Sponsored guide placement $250 per placement in an existing
  /guides page, labeled Sponsored. Newsletter sponsor slot $150 per weekly issue
  of Grade A Eats This Week, labeled Sponsored. Catering referral partnership
  $50 per accepted catering lead from /catering, or 10% of the first order
  (partner’s choice), no upfront fee.
  Contact: partner@eatrealfoodnyc.com
  https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/contact

## Data sources

- NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH) Open Data
  Dataset 43nn-pn8j, DOHMH New York City Restaurant Inspection Results:
  https://data.cityofnewyork.us/Health/DOHMH-New-York-City-Restaurant-Inspection-Results/43nn-pn8j
  Health inspection grades: A, B, and C. Scores are violation points.
  A is 0-13 points, B is 14-27, C is 28 or more.
- Community ratings sourced from Google Maps
- Dietary tags applied only when a restaurant explicitly identifies that way
  or has substantial dedicated menu coverage

## What agents should not attempt

- Submitting reviews or experiences — submissions are queued for manual review
- Booking reservations — this site is a directory, not a booking platform
- Accessing private user data — saved lists stay in the browser
